_comment: 'Welcome to Monrovia', the first mission on a new game (read by proto3d/game/tutorial.gd). Each step has a kind (reach, enter_vehicle, drive_to, exit_vehicle, buy, pickup, hit_target, open_wheel, save_at), where it happens ('at': start_car, poi:<id>, nearest:<poi type>, behind_player:<metres>) and what to show: 'say' is Auntie Musu's line, 'hint' the objective, with {action} replaced by the key or gamepad button (or {move}, {drive}). Skippable: Settings > Gameplay > Tutorial on a new game.
title: Welcome to Monrovia

steps.say: Kollie! Welcome home, my child. Come, walk with me small.
steps.hint: Walk to the marker with {move}. Look around with {look}.

steps.say: Take that taxi there. Don't worry, it's my nephew's own.
Drive us to the cookshop. My belly is talking.
steps.hint: Drive to the cookshop: {drive}. Handbrake {p3_jump}. Check the map with {p3_map}.

steps.say: Go on, buy yourself something to eat. Food puts your health back.
steps.hint: Walk up to the FOOD sign and press {p3_use}, then pick something

steps.say: Monrovia can be rough at night. Take this bat, just in case.
steps.hint: Pick up the bat (walk over it)

steps.say: Show me how you hold it. Hit the old sack there.
Good! When you carry more than one thing, pick it from the wheel.
steps.hint: Hold {p3_wheel} to open the weapon wheel

steps.say: Now go rest at your room in Fiamah, by Sinkor. You can save your progress there.
steps.hint: Go to your safehouse in Fiamah (marked on the map, {p3_map}) and press {p3_use} to rest and save
